mapper.sql: select r.review_id, r.submission_id, r.submission_version, r.teacher_id, t.nick_name as teacher_name, r.total_score, r.review_comment, r.status, r.review_time, r.publish_time, r.return_reason, r.return_deadline, r.is_return, s.task_id, tk.title as task_title, u.nick_name as student_name, p.student_no, tk.total_score as total_score_full, tk.score_mode from edu_review r left join edu_submission s on s.submission_id = r.submission_id left join edu_task tk on tk.task_id = s.task_id left join sys_user t on t.user_id = r.teacher_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = s.user_id left join edu_user_profile p on p.user_id = s.user_id
mapper.select: where r.submission_id = #{submissionId} and r.submission_version = #{version} order by r.review_id desc limit 1

select s.submission_id, s.task_id, tk.title as task_title, u.nick_name as student_name, p.student_no, tk.total_score as total_score_full, tk.score_mode, s.version as submission_version, s.submit_time as review_time from edu_submission s join edu_task tk on tk.task_id = s.task_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = s.user_id left join edu_user_profile p on p.user_id = s.user_id where s.status = 2 and s.task_id = #{taskId}
and p.student_no like concat('%', #{studentNo}, '%')
and u.nick_name like concat('%', #{studentName}, '%')
and tk.course_id = #{courseId} order by s.submit_time
mapper.insert: insert into edu_review (submission_id, submission_version, teacher_id, total_score, review_comment, status, review_time, publish_time, return_reason, return_deadline, is_return, create_time) values (#{submissionId}, #{submissionVersion}, #{teacherId}, #{totalScore}, #{reviewComment}, #{status}, #{reviewTime}, #{publishTime}, #{returnReason}, #{returnDeadline}, #{isReturn}, sysdate())
mapper.select: select rs.id, rs.review_id, rs.item_id, rs.score, si.item_name, si.weight, si.max_score from edu_review_score rs left join edu_task_score_item si on si.item_id = rs.item_id where rs.review_id = #{reviewId} order by si.sort_no, rs.id
mapper.insert:
insert into edu_review_score (review_id, item_id, score) values
(#{reviewId}, #{it.itemId}, #{it.score})
mapper.select: select count(1) from edu_submission s join edu_task tk on tk.task_id = s.task_id join edu_course c on c.course_id = tk.course_id where s.status = 2 and c.teacher_id = #{teacherId}
